To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“CI is a process, which is a collection of tools and techniques used to collect, analyze and distribute competitive intelligence.”
the CI process consists of three main steps: (1) collection of information, (2) analysis of information and (3) dissemination of information.

CI is a process of gathering and evaluating information from a wide variety of internal and external sources, and analyzing the data to identify and understand trends, opportunities and threats that may affect the organization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use these new tools in the CI process, and how to make the most out of the data they provide.
how to make the best use of the available tools and technologies to support CI programs.
the application and use of competitive intelligence (CI).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CI process is not a one-size-fits-all approach.
the CI program should be designed and implemented in a way to ensure its success in the organization.
the CI tools and technologies are not yet ready to be used in a CI process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CI is a process, not a tool, and that the tools are the means to an end, not the end itself.
we have provided a better understanding of the CI process and tools for the managers of CI program to develop and evaluate a set of tools and processes to apply in their industry.
the process of CI is still in the early stage of development, and that there is a lack of a comprehensive framework that integrates the process and tools for CI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single tool or technique that will provide a competitive edge to an organization.
the CI process is a complex and dynamic process and that it is important to understand how the process is being used to make decisions in an organization.
the process of CI is not just about collecting and storing data but it is about analyzing the data in order to make sense of the information that is collected.
